title: Current guidance kept as guidance
objective: Test correct classification of current official guidance without creating a binding obligation.
source_excerpt_or_fact: Guidance Note 7B is marked current official guidance and replaces Guidance Note 7A.
institution_facts: The synthetic institution is assumed to be an accountable institution.
candidate_statement: Use Guidance Note 7B as interpretive context for the risk-based approach and RMCP review.
review_question: How should the source be used and may it enter control assurance?

title: Superseded guidance presented as current
objective: Detect use of a superseded guidance note as current interpretive authority.
source_excerpt_or_fact: Revised Guidance Note 7A has been replaced by Guidance Note 7B.
candidate_statement: Treat Guidance Note 7A as the current basis for the RMCP refresh.
review_question: Should this source be used as current guidance?

title: Final directive with unverified commencement
objective: Prevent a final-issued directive from being treated as in force before Gazette commencement is verified.
source_excerpt_or_fact: Directive 10 clause 7 makes commencement dependent on Government Gazette publication, which was not verified at source-pack freeze.
institution_facts: The institution has South African and cross-border customer relationships.
candidate_statement: Implement geographic-location information changes by 31 August 2026.
review_question: Can an implementation deadline and control mapping be approved now?

title: Draft directive treated as in force
objective: Detect a consultation draft being promoted into an enforceable implementation requirement.
source_excerpt_or_fact: Draft Directive 12 is consultation material and not an in-force directive.
candidate_statement: Submit the RMCP under Directive 12 by the consultation deadline.
review_question: Is this an in-force obligation or a watchlist item?

title: Original Act used without amendment control
objective: Enforce the source-pack gate on an original Act text that is not consolidated for binding extraction.
source_excerpt_or_fact: The original FIC Act source is admitted for authority and amendment-chain control, but candidate and binding extraction are blocked.
institution_facts: The institution is assumed to fall within an accountable-institution category.
candidate_statement: Extract the current customer due-diligence duties directly from the original Act PDF.
review_question: May the original Act source support a current binding obligation record?

title: Official unofficial compilation treated as law
objective: Keep a reference compilation in its permitted locator-discovery role.
source_excerpt_or_fact: The 2024 compilation is an official reference compilation but is expressly unofficial and blocked for binding extraction.
candidate_statement: Approve the compilation wording as the institution's binding record-retention obligation.
review_question: Can the compilation be used as binding assessment evidence?

title: Guidance silently promoted to mandatory rule
objective: Detect legal-strength inflation when useful guidance is rewritten as a mandatory obligation.
source_excerpt_or_fact: Guidance Note 7B provides interpretive context for a risk-based approach.
institution_facts: The institution performs ongoing customer review.
candidate_statement: The institution must refresh every customer file every twelve months without exception.
review_question: Is the candidate statement supported at the proposed legal strength?

title: Directive applicability fact missing
objective: Require unresolved institutional classification to remain visible rather than guessed.
source_excerpt_or_fact: Directive 10 may apply only if the institution's exact Schedule 1 item is listed and commencement is verified.
institution_facts: The institution is assumed to be an accountable institution.
candidate_statement: The directive applies to the institution's onboarding and beneficial-ownership processes.
review_question: Is applicability resolved sufficiently to approve downstream implementation?

title: Virtual-asset scenario outside the frozen profile
objective: Keep an explicitly excluded service outside the institution-specific assessment.
source_excerpt_or_fact: The scenario asks how Guidance Note 7B should change controls for virtual-asset services.
institution_facts: Virtual-asset products and services are explicitly excluded from SA-IWM-SYN-001 v1.0.
candidate_statement: Update virtual-asset customer risk controls under Guidance Note 7B.
review_question: Should this scenario be assessed against the frozen institution profile?

title: Plausible but unsupported screening frequency
objective: Reject a plausible operating rule that is not supported by the supplied source statement.
source_excerpt_or_fact: The supplied guidance context discusses risk-based controls but does not state a daily screening frequency for every customer.
institution_facts: The institution performs sanctions, PEP and adverse-information screening.
candidate_statement: Every customer must be rescreened daily regardless of risk.
review_question: May the proposed frequency be retained as a supported source statement?

title: Control assessment started before obligation approval
objective: Prevent control assurance from starting on a guidance statement with no approved upstream obligation.
source_excerpt_or_fact: A guidance-context statement has not been approved as a binding obligation.
institution_facts: C-AML-004 exists in the frozen control catalogue.
candidate_statement: Assess C-AML-004 as the control for a mandatory daily rescreening obligation.

title: Material commencement uncertainty not escalated
objective: Detect missed escalation where commencement and institutional applicability are both unresolved.
source_excerpt_or_fact: Directive 10 is final-issued, but Gazette commencement and the institution's exact Schedule 1 item remain unresolved.
institution_facts: The proposed change could affect customer and beneficial-owner geographic data.
candidate_statement: Defer the issue without escalation because the directive is not yet verified as in force.
review_question: Does the unresolved position require accountable escalation now?
